objects.description: [UNC3886](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1048) has named a file ‘fgfm’ in an attempt to disguise it as the legitimate service ‘fgfmd’ which facilitates communication between FortiManager and the FortiGate firewall.(Citation: Mandiant Fortinet Zero Day)
objects.description_fa: [UNC3886](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1048) یک فایل را "fgfm" نامگذاری کرده است تا آن را به عنوان سرویس قانونی "fgfmd" پنهان کند که ارتباط بین FortiManager و فایروال FortiGate را تسهیل می‌کند.[[[CTI_PRESERVE_0]] (Citation: Mandiant Fortinet Zero Day)
